sgRNA-level phenotype distribution with per-gene strip chart

Source: R/qc.R
qc_plot_sgrna_phenotype_distribution.Rd

Produces a two-panel figure. The top panel shows the kernel density of fc_col log2 fold-changes for all real-gene sgRNAs (guide-counter exact counts). The bottom panel shows jittered dot strips for the top n_promoters and top n_suppressors hit genes ranked by Chronos tvb_effect, coloured by hit classification. Guide consistency across sgRNAs is the key QC signal: a robust hit should shift most or all of its guides in the same direction.

Usage

qc_plot_sgrna_phenotype_distribution(
  sgrna_fc,
  hit_df,
  class_colours,
  fc_col = "Top_vs_Bottom_log2FC",
  n_promoters = 6L,
  n_suppressors = 6L,
  ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL|SAFE_TARGETING",
  restrict_genes = NULL,
  x_limits = c(-4.5, 4.5),
  interactive = FALSE,
  base_size = 11
)

Arguments

sgrna_fc

Data frame of per-sgRNA fold changes, as produced by guide-counter. Must contain columns sgRNA, Gene, and the column named by fc_col.

hit_df

Gene-level hit table. Must contain columns Gene, ctrl_type ("Real gene" for real genes), classification, and tvb_effect (Top-vs-Bottom Chronos effect).

class_colours

Named character vector mapping classification labels to hex colours.

fc_col

Name of the fold-change column in sgrna_fc to plot (default "Top_vs_Bottom_log2FC").

n_promoters

Number of top invasion promoters to show (default 6).

n_suppressors

Number of top invasion suppressors to show (default 6).

ctrl_pattern

Regex matching control sgRNA gene names to exclude from the density and strips (default "NEG_CTRL|SAFE_TARGETING").

restrict_genes

Optional character vector of gene names to restrict candidate hits to (e.g. genes confirmed by both Chronos and MAGeCK). When NULL (default) all classified hit genes are eligible.

x_limits

Numeric vector of length 2 giving x-axis limits (default c(-4.5, 4.5)).

interactive

Logical. FALSE (default) returns a combined patchwork static figure (density + strips). TRUE returns a plotly strip chart only (with hover tooltips showing sgRNA, gene, and LFC).

base_size

Base font size passed to .theme_qc() (default 11).

Value

A patchwork ggplot object (interactive = FALSE) or a plotly object (interactive = TRUE).
